title: Screening excludes draft unexpected deaths; certification prerequisite is undocumented
actual: Three fresh synthetic unexpected deaths (patients5/6/7, deaths3/4/5) were recorded201 with expected_death=false and current server timestamps. GET /incident-screening returned200 [] while these deaths were Draft. After completing and certifying only death3, the same GET returned Death:3; deaths4/5 still Draft were absent. This is a narrowed documentation finding, not an allegation that draft deaths must clinically be screened.

Please document the actual certification prerequisite in the contract/workflow/screen help, or clarify whether draft unexpected deaths were intended to appear. POST /deaths/{death_id}/certify already documents notification at certification. No frontend-generated candidates or guessed keys added.
